title: Mindarus
summary: Raleigh names Mindarus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Mindarus, who commanded the fleet of the Lacedaemonians, slaine when Alcibiades destroyed it. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter VIII, §. X, sig. 432b
